targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count() / uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS events_per_user
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)

WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
    AND param_engagement_time_msec > 60000
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
)
SELECT
  count() / uniqExact(e.user_pseudo_id) AS events_per_active_user
FROM analytics_events e
INNER JOIN active_users a ON e.user_pseudo_id = a.user_pseudo_id
WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND e.event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND e.event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND e.event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS "Event Users"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  e.event_date AS time,
  uniqExact(e.user_pseudo_id) * 100.0 / a.total AS "% of All Users"
FROM analytics_events e
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT event_date, uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS total
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY event_date
) a ON e.event_date = a.event_date
WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND e.event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND e.event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND e.event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY e.event_date, a.total
ORDER BY e.event_date

SELECT
  platform,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND platform IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT
  app_info_version,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND app_info_version IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY app_info_version
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH all_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
), events AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    count() as count
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = '${event_name}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT
  all_users.event_date AS time,
  sum(ifNull(events.count, 0)) / uniqExact(all_users.user_pseudo_id) AS "Avg"
FROM all_users
LEFT JOIN events ON all_users.event_date = events.event_date
  AND all_users.user_pseudo_id = events.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY all_users.event_date
ORDER BY all_users.event_date
